description: GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a leading global healthcare solutions provider of advanced medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and AI, cloud and software solutions that help clinicians tackle the world's most complex diseases, and has approximately 54,000 colleagues dedicated to its purpose to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Serving patients and providers for nearly 130 years, it delivers bold innovations designed for the next era of medicine to help clinicians deliver more personalized, precise patient care, complemented by broad service capabilities and a strong operational culture supported by its lean business system, Heartbeat. It generates revenue from the sale of medical devices, consumable products, service capabilities and AI-enabled cloud and software solutions, serving customers in over 160 countries with a global team of approximately 9,700 sales professionals and 8,900 field service engineers.
